description: Your patron is a powerful spirit weapon or cursed blade.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.description: Use CHA for weapon attack/damage rolls with pact weapon.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: Curse creature within 30 feet. Crits at 19-20. Gain temp HP on kill.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.description: Summon ghost of hexblade curse victim to attack enemies.

features.name: Armor Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.
